propositions: Three existing auto-bug filers (heartbeat-alert, binding-drift-alert, conflict-filer) lack dedup, template standardization, and abort-on-empty guards, causing duplicate filings and silent breakage on gate changes.

Heartbeat filer must implement 2-consecutive-red threshold by querying workflow run history (gh api repos/{repo}/actions/workflows/{file}/runs) without introducing new state stores, with query failures treated as first-red.

All three filers must use stable per-check dedup tags searched via has-tag, templated bodies with check name/first-red-time/run-URL/failing-output, abort-if-empty exit 1, and detected_by stamping; binding-drift gets no threshold (drift is persistent); conflict-filer gets no auto-close (needs investigation).
Accumulation comment dedup must check the target ticket's own comment history for a marker line <24h old, using the ticket store as durable state with no new store introduction.
Bug-creation contract must be documented (rebar create args, exit codes, dedup search command, REBAR_DETECTED_BY env) and referenced by all filers to ensure well-formed automated filing.
